## skenv completion

Generate the autocompletion script for bash, zsh or fish

### Synopsis

Generate the autocompletion script for skenv for bash, zsh or fish.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

```
skenv completion [flags]
```

### Examples

```console
$ source <(skenv completion bash)
$ skenv completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_skenv"
$ skenv completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/skenv.fish
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for completion
```
